newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's J.Martins hit by sale order.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's J.Martins hit by sale order.

text.p: Retailer Jeronimo Martins fell 2.5 percent to 11,449 escudos, a level at which it appeared to find some support, traders said.

Earlier, the stock had touched a session low of 11,001 escudos, some 6.3 percent down on Wednesday's close, with a significant sale order from a non-resident being the main source of the weakness, traders said.
"There is a big sale order from abroad, although the person who actually drove the stock to its low was local not foreign," said one trader.
They said that there appeared to be some support for the share around 11,500 escudos but everything would depend on whether the foreign sale order had now been completed.
